# Free AI Credits — Full Content

> Complete set of active free AI credit offers with summaries, claim context and source links — concatenated for LLM ingestion (Claude Code / Cursor). Generated at build time from src/data/offers.json and src/data/details.json.

Source: https://freetokens.custats.info/ — generated 2026-10-07T13:35:15Z — 172 of 212 active offers (truncated to stay under the 200KB llms-full budget; full directory at https://freetokens.custats.info/).

Trust fields: review_status, verification, signup, last_checked — the same schema values the short index defines at https://freetokens.custats.info/llms.txt. An offer's expiry date is its enrollment deadline — the last date to claim — not how long the credits stay valid. When a provider states how long claimed credits last, that term is in the amount text.

- Summary: Hetzner's experimental Inference API exposes open-weight LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible REST API (base URL https://inference.hetzner.com/api/v1 exposing /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions) and is free of charge while in experimental status — performance and availability are not guaranteed and it is not intended for production. Current models: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 (MoE, 35B total / 3B active, vision) and Qwen3.8-27B (dense), both with 262,144-token context and text+image input. Rate limits per API key: 4M input and 100k output tokens per 60 seconds, plus 10 requests per 60 seconds; the /v1/models response is the definitive live model list.
- Claim steps: Create a Hetzner account and API token at experiments.hetzner.com (per curator input; docs confirm Bearer-token auth; no card mentioned). | Call https://inference.hetzner.com/api/v1 with any OpenAI-compatible SDK or curl using 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. | List live models via GET /v1/models — the response is the definitive model list during the experiment.

Eligibility tracks: maintainers (500+ dependent repos, 100+ dependent packages, or 200k+ monthly downloads), core contributors on recognized foundation/language projects, active contributors (100+ merged PRs on others' repos in 12 months), community builders (20+ unique external merged-PR contributors in 12 months), critical infrastructure (OpenSSF criticality score >=0.4), plus a discretionary ecosystem-impact track. General requirements: natural person, GitHub account at least two years old, public OSS activity in the last 90 days, and at least one OSI-approved-licensed project.
